verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Raygun has credentials: an external access token used for the Deployments API and symbol/source-map uploads, and a Personal Access Token for the v3 API. Nothing documents issuing tokens with restricted scopes, per-resource permissions, or least-privilege limits, so having a token alone does not deliver scoped agent credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
